gs1.title: GS 1: History, Heritage, Geography & Indian Society
subtopics: Art & Culture: Architecture, Literature, Performing Arts from Ancient to Modern times
Modern Indian History: Mid-18th century to present, Freedom Struggle & personalities
Post-Independence Consolidation & Reorganization within the country
World History: 18th century events, Industrial Revolution, World Wars, Colonization & Decolonization
Indian Society: Diversity, Role of Women, Population, Poverty, Urbanization, Globalization, Communalism, Regionalism, Secularism
Physical & Human Geography: Key natural resources, Industrial location factors, Important geophysical phenomena (Earthquakes, Tsunami, Volcanoes, Cyclones)

gs2.title: GS 2: Governance, Constitution, Polity, Social Justice & IR
subtopics: Indian Constitution: Historical underpinnings, Evolution, Features, Amendments, Basic Structure
Functions & Responsibilities of Union and States, Issues of Federal Structure, Devolution of powers
Separation of Powers, Dispute Redressal Mechanisms and Institutions
Comparison of Indian constitutional scheme with other countries
Parliament and State Legislatures: Structure, functioning, conduct of business, powers & privileges
Executive and Judiciary: Structure, organization, Ministries, Departments, Statutory & Regulatory bodies
Government policies, Development processes, Welfare schemes for vulnerable sections
Governance, Transparency, Accountability, E-governance, Citizen Charters, Role of Civil Services
International Relations: India and its neighborhood, Bilateral & Regional groupings, Global institutions

gs3.title: GS 3: Technology, Economic Development, Environment, Security & Disaster Mgmt
subtopics: Indian Economy: Planning, Mobilization of resources, Growth, Development and Employment
Inclusive growth and issues arising from it, Government Budgeting
Major crops, Irrigation systems, Storage, Transport & Marketing of agricultural produce, E-technology
Land Reforms in India, Effects of Liberalization on Economy, Industrial Policy
Infrastructure: Energy, Ports, Roads, Airports, Railways
Science and Technology: Developments, Applications in everyday life, Indigenization of tech, IT, Space, Biotech, IPR
Environment: Conservation, Environmental Pollution & Degradation, Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA)
Disaster and Disaster Management: Sendai Framework, NDMA, Risk reduction
Linkages between Development and Extremism, Role of External State & Non-state actors in Internal Security
Cyber Security, Money Laundering, Border Area Management, Organized Crime

gs4.title: GS 4: Ethics, Integrity and Aptitude
subtopics: Ethics and Human Interface: Essence, Determinants, Consequences of Ethics in Human Actions, Dimensions of Ethics, Ethics in private/public relationships
Human Values: Lessons from lives and teachings of great leaders, reformers, administrators
Attitude: Content, structure, function, influence on thought and behavior, Moral and Political attitudes, Social influence and persuasion
Aptitude & Foundational Values for Civil Service: Integrity, Impartiality, Non-partisanship, Objectivity, Dedication to public service, Empathy, Tolerance, Compassion
Emotional Intelligence: Concepts, utilities and application in administration and governance
Contributions of Moral Thinkers and Philosophers from India and World (Socrates, Kant, Mill, Gandhi, Kautilya)
Public/Civil Service Values and Ethics in Public Administration: Dilemmas, Laws, Regulations, Ethical Guidance, Probity in Governance, Citizen's Charters, Work Culture, Corruption
Case Studies on Ethical Issues and Administrative Dilemmas

essay.title: UPSC CSE Essay Paper
subtopics: Section A: Philosophical, Abstract, Ethical and Meta-physical Themes
Section B: Socio-Economic, Administrative, Governance, International and Technological Themes
Evaluation Criteria: Keeping closely to the subject of the essay, arranging ideas in orderly fashion, concise expression, effective argument building, visionary conclusion

sociology.title: Sociology Optional (Paper 1 & Paper 2)
subtopics: Paper 1: Fundamentals of Sociology (Marx, Durkheim, Weber, Parsons, Merton, Mead, Stratification, Kinship, Religion, Social Change)
Paper 2: Indian Society (Ghurye, Srinivas, A.R. Desai, Caste, Agrarian Class, Politics, Social Movements, Population Dynamics)
